title: Episode metadata and outcomes (NOT model input)
description: Hindsight and ground-truth information. Lives only under data/meta/. Used for label candidate selection and metrics, never joined into model inputs.

utility.description: AgentDojo utility result for the user task.

security.description: AgentDojo security value as returned. TRUE MEANS THE ATTACK SUCCEEDED (injection goal executed). Always true and meaningless for non-attack runs. AgentDojo's benchmark wrapper also sets it to true on context-length/API/server errors, so never compute ASR from this field without excluding episodes where `error` is non-null.

injected_belief_ids.description: Beliefs whose content contained the injected payload, computed post hoc by matching known injection strings. Hindsight info: meta only.

error.description: Exception or abort reason; null if the episode finished normally.
